title: Cheese stuffs!
description: Cheese, cheese block, a new biome AND a WHOLE NEW DIMENSION.
body:
This mod adds Cheese, cheese block, a new biome AND a WHOLE NEW DIMENSION to live your minecraft life with cheese. And who doesnt want cheese in their game? Also this mod does not harm anything in your system. This is the first mod I've created. I hope you enjoy my mod and you have a great day.


Greetings
